items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system and is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Action Required: Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (APSB25-88)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, also known as SessionReaper, allows an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API. A hotfix (VULN-32437-2-4-X-patch) is available for remediation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
